children: New Delhi, Sept. 10 -- Apple's first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, starts at Rs.2,99,900 in India. The high-end 2TB variant is priced at Rs.4,49,900, putting it in the price range of several entry-level hatchbacks sold in the country.

The comparison is based on the iPhone Duo's official India price and the ex-showroom prices of cars. Some of the hatchbacks available in a similar price range include the Maruti Suzuki S-Presso, Maruti Suzuki Alto K10, Renault Kwid, Tata Tiago and Maruti Suzuki Celerio.
The iPhone Duo is available in four storage options in India. Prices start at Rs.2,99,900 for the 256GB model and go up to Rs.4,49,900 for the 2TB variant.
The foldable iPhone features a 7.6-inch inner display, a titanium frame and Apple's A20 Pro chip. It also offers up to 2TB of storage.

As per Maruti Suzuki, the Maruti Suzuki S-Presso is priced between Rs.3.49 lakh and Rs.5.27 lakh (ex-showroom). It is priced at Rs.1 lakh less than the 2TB iPhone Duo. A 1.0-litre K10C petrol engine with Dual Jet and Dual VVT technology powers the hatchback. It is also equipped with an idle start-stop system.

Priced at Rs.3.69 lakh onwards to Rs.5.44 lakh (ex-showroom), the Maruti Suzuki Alto K10 is priced at Rs.5.44 lakh. The base model is priced at Rs.80,900, cheaper than its highest-priced iPhone Duo. The Alto K10 is powered by a 1.0-litre K-Series petrol engine that is mated to a manual or AMT transmission. A CNG version is also available at the factory.
Renault India has marked the price of the Renault Kwid between Rs.4.53 lakh and Rs.5.60 lakh (ex-showroom). The starting price of its Rs.3,100 is more than the iPhone Duo 2TB.
As per Tata Motors, Tata Tiago's price starts at Rs.4.70 lakh and goes up to Rs.8.55 lakh (ex-showroom). It comes with petrol and CNG engines, manual and AMT gearbox.

The price of the Maruti Suzuki Celerio ranges from Rs.4.69 lakh to Rs.6.75 lakh (ex-showroom). The base price of the phone is Rs.19,100, on top of the iPhone Duo 2 TB's base price. The Celerio is powered by a 1.0-litre petrol engine (also available with a manual or AMT), and a CNG version is also offered as a factory fitment.

Prices mentioned are ex-showroom and can vary by variant, location and applicable offers. Published by HT Digital Content Services with permission from MINT. For any query with respect to this article or any other content requirement, please contact Editor at contentservices@htdigital.in

title: Would you buy an iPhone Duo or a hatchback? 5 cars priced around Rs.4.49 lakh
